why: MATLAB calls a function file by its file name, whatever name its function line declares (MATLAB doc 'Create Functions in Files': the file name and the name of the first function should match, and MATLAB goes by the file name when they differ), so renaming the declared name inside `scale.m` changes nothing another file reaches: the call stays linked, and the sync's definition delta stays empty (step 13; pinned in matlab-sync.test.ts 'a function file whose main function is renamed inside the file, or whose body changes, keeps an empty definition delta').
